metadata.case_name: LAU KIN WAI DANNY v. CHAN WAI SANG & ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: technician (1 July 1999 to 1 March 2000); thereafter casual construction site worker and excavator operator

injuries.body_part: right calcaneum / right heel / right ankle
source: X-ray showed fracture of the right calcaneum.
X-ray was taken by Dr Cheng and it revealed no evidence of fracture. Dr Cheng's observation was that if there had been a fracture, it has probably healed without a trace.
Dr Cheng ... regarded this as a minor impairment of ankle and assessed it as 5% lower limb impairment and 2% impairment of the whole person.

injuries.description: small abrasion over his left frontal head region
source: He also had a small abrasion over his left frontal head region.
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of other or unspecified sites of head

manifestations.description: After he got up from the ground, the Plaintiff felt pain in his right leg and foot.
There was a small abrasion over his left frontal head region.
Examination showed swelling and tenderness on the right heel of the Plaintiff.
Residual discomfort and mild residue stiffness and weakness.
Reduction of 5% in terms of working efficiency (assessed by Dr Cheng).
He would feel discomfort when he ran or stood for more than half an hour.
He could no longer enjoy swimming, playing football, basketball or badminton.

treatments_received: attended Accident and Emergency Department of Kwong Wah Hospital and was given painkiller
attended Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology (conservative treatment) on 15 January 1999 and follow-up treatments

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Could no longer enjoy swimming, playing football, basketball or badminton.
Would feel discomfort when he ran or stood for more than half an hour.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Felt unable to carry heavy objects.
Reduction of 5% in terms of working efficiency affecting ability to perform onerous duties (assessed by Dr Cheng).

comparable_cases.injury_description: Severing of the Achilles tendon; hospitalized for 8 days; some scarring and muscle wasting in the calf area.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Ming v. Wayfine Investment Ltd.
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fracture of the left lateral malleolus; underwent open reduction, internal fixation and bone grafting; hospitalized for more than a month.
